scheme_name: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Accidental Injuries
description:
The Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana is a significant welfare scheme launched by the Government of Bihar. 

This scheme was officially launched on 1st January 2020. 

It aims to provide social security and financial assistance to unorganized sector workers in the state of Bihar. 

The scheme is specifically designed to support workers who face accidental injuries while performing their duties. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to ensure that workers receive timely financial assistance in case of accidental injuries. 

The government aims to provide immediate relief to the injured workers and their families. 

The scheme targets to cover a large number of unorganized sector workers across various industries. 

The Bihar government has set a measurable target of providing assistance to at least 1 million workers under this scheme within the first three years of its implementation. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is structured based on the severity of the injury. 

For minor injuries, the scheme provides a one-time financial assistance of ₹25,000. 

For moderate injuries, the assistance amount increases to ₹50,000. 

In cases of severe injuries that result in permanent disability, the assistance can go up to ₹1,00,000. 

In the unfortunate event of death due to an accident, the family of the deceased worker is entitled to receive ₹2,00,000. 

This financial support is crucial for families who may face economic hardships due to the loss of their primary breadwinner. 

Eligibility criteria for the scheme are clearly defined. 

Workers must be aged between 18 and 60 years to qualify for assistance. 

The scheme is open to all unorganized sector workers, including daily wage laborers, construction workers, and artisans. 

There are no specific educational qualifications required to apply for this scheme. 

However, applicants must provide proof of employment in the unorganized sector. 

Income criteria stipulate that the monthly income of the worker should not exceed ₹15,000. 

This income limit ensures that the benefits reach those who are most in need. 

The application process for the Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana is straightforward. 

Interested applicants must fill out an application form, which can be obtained from local government offices or online portals. 

The application form requires personal details such as name, age, address, and occupation. 

Applicants must also provide details of the accident and the nature of the injury sustained. 

Required documents include proof of identity such as an Aadhar card or voter ID. 

Additionally, applicants must submit medical reports confirming the nature of the injury. 

Proof of employment in the unorganized sector must also be included. 

Once the application is completed, it should be submitted to the local district labor office. 

The application will then be reviewed by officials to determine eligibility. 

Disbursement of financial assistance is typically processed within 30 days of application approval. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Labor Resources, Government of Bihar. 

The department is responsible for overseeing the application process and ensuring timely disbursement of funds. 

For any queries or assistance, individuals can contact the Department of Labor Resources at their official helpline number, which is available on the government website. 

The Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana is part of a larger initiative by the Bihar government to enhance the welfare of unorganized sector workers. 

The government recognizes the challenges faced by these workers and aims to provide them with a safety net. 

Statistics indicate that a significant portion of the workforce in Bihar is employed in the unorganized sector. 

This highlights the importance of such welfare schemes in providing social security. 

The scheme also aims to raise awareness about workplace safety and the rights of workers. 

By providing financial assistance, the government hopes to reduce the economic burden on families affected by workplace accidents. 

Furthermore, the scheme encourages employers to prioritize safety measures in the workplace. 

The Bihar government has allocated a budget of ₹100 crores for the implementation of this scheme in the first year. 

This budget is expected to cover the financial assistance for a substantial number of workers. 

The government plans to review and assess the scheme annually to ensure its effectiveness. 

Feedback from beneficiaries will be collected to make necessary adjustments to the scheme. 

The Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana is a vital step towards improving the living conditions of unorganized sector workers. 

It reflects the government's commitment to social welfare and economic development. 

The scheme not only provides financial assistance but also aims to empower workers by recognizing their contributions to the economy. 

As of October 2023, the scheme continues to operate and evolve based on the needs of the workforce in Bihar. 

The government remains focused on ensuring that unorganized sector workers receive the support they need in times of crisis. 

Overall, the Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana is an essential initiative for enhancing the social security framework in the state. 

It serves as a model for similar welfare schemes across India. 

The scheme's success will depend on effective implementation and active participation from the target beneficiaries. 

The Bihar government is committed to making this scheme a cornerstone of its social welfare policies. 

In conclusion, the Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana provides critical support to unorganized sector workers facing accidental injuries. 

The comprehensive financial assistance structure aims to alleviate the economic impact of such injuries on workers and their families. 

Through this scheme, the government seeks to create a safer and more secure working environment for all unorganized workers in Bihar.
